candidates.change_summary: Delete `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the stored balance never increases after a Put.
Replace the balance update with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the balance is overwritten rather than accumulated.
Replace the unlockTime update with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past _unlockTime can shorten the lock instead of keeping block.timestamp.
Delete the overflow-protecting require so an overflowing deposit no longer reverts and instead stores an overflowed balance.
Replace the unlockTime update with `acc.unlockTime = 0;` so every deposit immediately unlocks the holder's funds.
Change the balance check from >= to > so withdrawals of exactly the full balance or exactly MinSum are rejected differently.
Delete the statement that updates acc.balance after a successful withdrawal, so the recorded balance is not reduced.
Change the Ether amount sent in the external call from _am to the full acc.balance.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call in the success branch, so successful Collect calls are no longer logged.
